rows.text: The Company expects adjusted EPS of between $0.32 and $0.33 per share for the fourth quarter of 2026 and at least $1.04 per share for the full year 2026.
The Company expects adjusted EPS of between $0.26 and $0.28 per share for the third quarter of 2026 and at least $0.98 per share for the full year 2026.
